newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica retail share price set at 3,239 ptas.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica retail share price set at 3,239 ptas.

text.p: Spain's state holding company SEPPa set the final share price for the retail tranche of its sale of Telefonica de Espana at 3,239 pesetas, a four percent discount on its average weighted bourse price on Monday.
The institutional price for both the domestic and international tranches was fixed at 3,360 pesetas.
Telefonica said the institutional tranche was four times oversubscribed.

Total demand for the Telefonica shares was 3.56 billion pesetas (1.057 million shares) -- 2.5 billion pesetas (768 million shares) in the retail tranche and 1.06 billion pesetas (319 million shares) in the institutional tranche.

Telefonica said it had increased the retail share offer to 114 million shares to ensure each investor received at least 100 shares. Those who subscribed for more received two percent of the amount requested over the minimum 100.
The investor who requested the maximum will get 155 shares for 502,045 pesetas.
The underwriters of the deal were given the option to buy up to 20 million shares and they were granted it.
The share offer was Spain's largest flotation ever, worth 5.0 percent of the bourse market capitalisation, Telefonica said. (( -- Madrid Newsroom +341 585 8341 ))
